title: Crispy Pork Belly Recipe - No Boil, No Fry, No Salt Crust หมูกรอบ
ldName: Simple Crispy Pork Belly with Bubbly Skin
ldIngredientsRaw: 500 g (16 oz) piece of pork belly, centre cut (see note)
½ tsp 5-spice powder (I have a recipe for this one the website, or you can buy)
¼ tsp table salt for the meat, plus another 1/4 tsp for the skin
¾ tsp (4 ml) finely chopped palm sugar, light brown sugar, or granulated sugar
½ tsp (2.5 ml) roasted chili flakes or any spicy chili powder (add more or less to taste)
A little chopped green onion, cilantro or mint (optional)
